This work contains material that is copyright Wizards of the Coast and/or other authors. All other original material in this work is copyright 2021 by Thomas Pfeifer.

Maxwell's Manual of Malicious Maladies contains descriptions of injuries and violence potentially resulting in permanent disability.This work makes use of humor and hyperbole in reference to this content. The designer of this work understands that it describes aspects of physical and mental disability and has made every effort to avoid language and ideas that are ableist. At core is intended to be empowering and promote empathy and understanding for people with physical and mental disabilities.

 

Note from the module developer

The contents of the journals and items included in this module where all created from the content of the original hombrew Maxwell's Manual of Malicious Maladies. All credits and information up to this point were included by the original author.
